neighbours.label: IPv6 / IP network stack: the '6' in IPv6 and 'stack' in IP or dual stack
fire: Our router now supports IPv6 addresses on every port.
The server runs a dual stack configuration with both protocols.
Packets are handled inside the kernel's IP stack, not in user space.
Most mobile carriers have switched their networks to IPv6 already.
Enable IPv6 in the adapter settings before running the test.
The firewall rules apply to the TCP/IP stack of the relay host.
Each device receives a global IPv6 prefix from the provider.
The bug was traced to the network stack of the embedded board.
quiet: Our router now supports guest passwords on every port.
The server runs a backup configuration with both disks.
Packets are handled inside the kernel's driver, not in user space.
Most mobile carriers have switched their networks to fibre already.
Enable Bluetooth in the adapter settings before running the test.
The firewall rules apply to the main gateway of the relay host.
Each device receives a unique name from the provider.
The bug was traced to the power supply of the embedded board.

notes: Card: '6' x12 (IPv6), ' stack'/'STACK'/'_stack' (dual stack, IP stack), getaddrinfo. - pole: '7' in 127.0.0.1, point-to-point.
